title: The Voice of Equity: A Systematic Evaluation of Bias Mitigation Techniques for Speech-Based Cognitive Impairment Detection Across Architectures and Demographics

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Equality of Opportunity (True Positive Rate) and Equalized Odds (True and False Positive Rates) for speech-based cognitive impairment detection models across distinct age groups (46–65, 66–80, and ≥81).
Comparing True Positive Rates (TPR) and False Positive Rates (FPR) across English, Spanish, and Mandarin speakers to assess demographic parity and subgroup disparities.
Measuring disparities in Equality of Opportunity (TPR) and Equalized Odds (TPR and FPR) across participants with different education levels (elementary, high school, undergraduate, and graduate).
Assessing True Positive Rate and False Positive Rate disparities between male and female speakers to evaluate Equality of Opportunity and Equalized Odds.
